about_the_game:
This is one (or more) story of reality, a story of youth, dreams, chains, and rebellion. Step into different lives of 7 ordinary teens through the "Doors", and embark on a journey to chase dreams with them, to fight, to face the shackles of darkened reality, and to rewrite their fate tightly locked with your choices.

"Summer and Score Through the Doors" is a realistic story AVG+ war chess RPG game

The game depicts a variety of real-life high school and college lives of the 7 protagonists, narrating stories about chasing dreams and finding identities. Confronted with shackles from reality, can their dreams finally come true? And when endings of the stories are directed to the same singularity, can you break the seemingly unsolvable fate?

In order to better show the plot, the game has added micro-innovative war chess gameplay. Feel the emotions you feel in the plot, whether it's sadness, joy, or anger, turn them into heavy punches against your enemies.

Gameplay has a variety of difficulties to choose from. Low difficulty makes it easy to get through the story, while higher difficulty is for players who love to challenge themselves!
